en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Amro Bin Al Afraq, from Abu Ubeyda,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It is befitting for the Momineen that, when one of them is left behind from his companions by a tree, then they both meet, they should shake hands’.
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ‘Amr ibn al-Afraq from abu ‘Ubaydah from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
It is a good idea for the believers to shake each other’s hands after one of them remains out of sight, even because of a tree in between.”
